suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Giải pháp AI & Kiến trúc Luồng Tự động hóa
suggestions.reasoning: As manual software QA postings face strong downward pressure from AI test generators with a declining market signal in Vietnam, pivoting toward AI solutions and workflow evaluation provides high resilience. The World Bank (2024) notes that up to 30% of routine cognitive jobs face automation pressure, requiring workers to transition toward systems design and model evaluation. TopCV Vietnam (2024) records a 180% surge in enterprise demand for AI Workflow Integrators with salaries reaching 35M - 60M VND/month.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 3 years of experience as a Manual Software QA in Da Nang has honed your ability to find deep edge-cases, communicate with developers, and write clear bug reports. These strengths directly translate into evaluating AI model outputs, identifying hallucinations, and designing robust system prompts. While you are currently building your foundational coding skills, your meticulous logic and patience fit perfectly into setting up reliable quality assurance frameworks for AI applications.
transferableSkillsMatch: Deep edge-case identification and analytical reasoning
Rigorous bug reporting and clear documentation
Cross-functional collaboration with engineering and product teams
Process adherence and structured agile workflows
skillsGap: Foundational Python programming for script customization
Hands-on LLM prompting and model benchmarking
Technical English communication for international remote collaboration

trajectories.pathTitle: Stay in Manual QA & Integrate AI Testing Tools
trajectories.pathTitleVi: Tiếp tục làm Manual QA và Tích hợp Công cụ AI Hỗ trợ
trajectories.shortDescription: Remain in traditional manual testing while adopting AI test generators (Copilot, Playwright AI) to speed up routine test case creation.
trajectories.rationale: Provides immediate stability within your current comfort zone, but carries high long-term automation risk as basic testing tasks get fully automated.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Integrate AI test generation assistants into your daily manual test case writing to boost throughput by 30%.

trajectories.pathTitle: Pivot to AI Quality Evaluation & Workflow Integration
trajectories.pathTitleVi: Chuyển hướng sang Đánh giá Chất lượng AI & Tích hợp Luồng công việc
trajectories.shortDescription: Leverage your edge-case testing background to transition into evaluating AI models, validating prompt outputs, and building automated workflows.
trajectories.rationale: Directly builds upon your core QA strengths while positioning you in a high-growth market sector with strong remote flexibility.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Enroll in Python micro-courses and practice writing structured test prompts for LLM outputs.

trajectories.pathTitle: Full Transition to Full-Stack AI Engineering
trajectories.pathTitleVi: Chuyển đổi hoàn toàn sang Kỹ sư AI Full-Stack
trajectories.shortDescription: Commit to intensive software engineering bootcamps to build full-scale machine learning models and enterprise applications from scratch.
trajectories.rationale: Offers the highest earning potential but requires a steep learning curve and heavy time investment that strains your available weekly hours.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Begin with foundational programming courses before committing to full software engineering tracks.
